caption: The drawing features a single object, a pear-shaped flask, centered on a plain, light beige background. The flask is rendered in shades of brown, giving it a metallic and antique appearance. The top of the flask has a cylindrical neck with a small, round cap and a protruding lever. There are two small metal loops attached to the sides of the upper body, as well as one loop on each side near the widest part. The body of the flask is decorated with a detailed embossed design that includes a stag's head at the top center, with large, upright antlers. Beneath the stag's head is a full-bodied deer standing on grass and surrounded by ornate foliage, including oak leaves and acorns, which cover the lower and side regions of the flask's body. The drawing is signed by the artist in small red text at the lower right of the object. The overall composition is simple and uncluttered, focusing attention on the central flask and its intricate decoration.
title: Powder Flask
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
